author: nickyeow

english.text: If I could be reborn, I would want to be the child of a rich family, then I'd be set for life.

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 ho2 ji5 tau4 toi1 ge3 waa2，ngo5 soeng2 hai2 go3 jau5 cin2 gaa1 ting4 dou6 ceot1 sai3，gam3 zau6 seng4 sai3 m4 sai2 jau1 laa3。
text: 如果可以投胎嘅話，我想喺個有錢家庭度出世，咁就成世唔使憂喇。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I jumped for joy.

jyutping: ngo5 hoi1 sam1 dou3 daan6 zo2 hei2 san1。
text: 我開心到彈咗起身。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The building will be completed in a year.

jyutping: go2 zo6 gin3 zuk1 mat6 wui5 hai2 jat1 nin4 zi1 noi6 hei2 jyun4。
text: 嗰座建築物會喺一年之內起完。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You can see the stars with your naked eye, and even better through a telescope.

jyutping: nei5 ho2 ji5 jung6 juk6 ngaan5 tai2 sing1 sing1，jung6 mong6 jyun5 geng3 ge3 waa2，zung6 ho2 ji5 tai2 dak1 cing1 co2 di1 tim1。
text: 你可以用肉眼睇星星，用望遠鏡嘅話，仲可以睇得清楚啲添。

author: nickyeow

english.text: The boy could not so much as write his own name.

jyutping: go2 go3 naam4 zai2 lin4 zi6 gei2 go3 ming4 dou1 m4 sik1 se2。
text: 嗰個男仔連自己個名都唔識寫。

author: nickyeow

english.text: If you want the taxi driver to have a tip, hand him too much money and say, "Keep the change."

jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 nei5 soeng2 bei2 di1 tip1 si2 go3 dik1 si2 si1 gei1，zau6 bei2 do1 di1 cin4 keoi5，gan1 zyu6 tung4 keoi5 gong2「m4 sai2 zaau2」。
text: 如果你想俾啲貼士個的士司機，就俾多啲錢佢，跟住同佢講「唔使找」。

author: nickyeow

english.text: I must remember to buy that book tomorrow.

jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jat1 ding6 jiu3 gei3 dak1 heoi3 maai5 go2 bun2 syu1。
text: 我聽日一定要記得去買嗰本書。

author: nickyeow

english.text: Could you turn the volume down?

jyutping: nei5 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 gaau3 sai3 seng1 di1 aa3？
text: 你可唔可以較細聲啲呀？

author: kaenif

english.text: Take medicine.

jyutping: sik6 joek6 laa1。
text: 食藥啦。

author: tigro1973

english.text: Please write down your contact address here.

jyutping: cing2 hai2 di1 dou6 se2 soeng5 nei5 ge3 lin4 lok3 dei6 zi2。
text: 請喺啲度寫上你嘅連絡地址。

author: nickyeow

english.text: They are generous with their money.

jyutping: keoi5 dei6 bei2 cin4 bei2 dak1 hou2 hou4 song2。
text: 佢哋俾錢俾得好豪爽。

author: nickyeow

english.text: We lost our way and did not know what to do.

jyutping: ngo5 dei6 dong6 sat1 lou6，m4 zi1 dim2 syun3 hou2。
text: 我哋蕩失路，唔知點算好。

author: nickyeow

english.text: It was expensive, too.

jyutping: zung6 hou2 gwai3 tim1。
text: 仲好貴添。

author: nickyeow

english.text: You haven't told anyone else, have you?

jyutping: nei5 mou5 waa6 dou3 bei2 kei4 taa1 jan4 teng1 gaa4 ho2？
text: 你冇話到俾其他人聽㗎可？

author: Da_Gigabyte

english.text: I love cake.

jyutping: ngo5 zung1 ji3 daan6 gou1。
text: 我鐘意蛋糕。

author: LeeSooHa

english.text: Which one do you like?

jyutping: nei5 zung1 ji3 bin1 jat1 go3 aa2？
text: 你鐘意邊一個啊？

english.text: All the old despots were demagogues; at least, they were demagogues whenever they were really trying to please or impress the demos. If they poured out beer for their vassals it was because both they and their vassals had a taste for beer. If (in some slightly different mood) they poured melted lead on their vassals, it was because both they and their vassals had a strong distaste for melted lead.

jyutping: so2 jau5 lou5 bou6 gwan1 dou1 hai6 man4 diu6 ze2；zi3 siu2，keoi5 dei6 hai6 man4 diu6 ze2，mui5 dong1 keoi5 dei6 zan1 hai6 soeng2 tou2 hou2 waak6 ze2 daa2 dung6 keoi5 dei6 ge3 san4 man4，zau6 hai6 jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 tung4 keoi5 dei6 ge3 san4 man4 dou1 zung1 ji3 be1 zau2(jau5 di1 loek6 jau5 m4 tung4 ge3 sam1 cing4）keoi5 dei6 zoeng1 jung4 faa3 ge3 jyun4 dou2 hai2 keoi5 dei6 ge3 san4 man4 san1 soeng6，hai6 jan1 wai6 keoi5 dei6 tung4 keoi5 dei6 ge3 san4 man4 dou1 deoi3 jung4 faa3 ge3 jyun4 jau5 koeng4 lit6 ge3 faan2 gam2。
text: 所有老暴君都係民調者；至少，佢哋係民調者，每當佢哋真係想討好或者打動佢哋嘅臣民，就係因為佢哋同佢哋嘅臣民都鍾意啤酒(有啲略有唔同嘅心情）佢哋將熔化嘅鉛倒喺佢哋嘅臣民身上，係因為佢哋同佢哋嘅臣民都對熔化嘅鉛有強烈嘅反感。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: A milk boy, passing on his way to the dairy, happened to walk down the lane which leads from the mews at the back of the hotel. He noticed that a ladder, which usually lay there, was raised against one of the windows of the second floor, which was wide open. After passing, he looked back and saw a man descend the ladder. He came down so quietly and openly that the boy imagined him to be some carpenter or joiner at work in the hotel.

jyutping: jat1 go3 naai5 zai2，hai2 heoi3 naai5 cong2 ge3 lou6 soeng6，haau2 hap6 gam2 haang4 lok6 zau2 dim3 hau6 min6 ge3 siu2 hong6，keoi5 lau4 ji3 dou3 jau5 tiu4 tai1，tung1 soeng4 dou1 hai6 hai2 dou6，hai2 ji6 lau4 ge3 kei4 zung1 jat1 go3 coeng1 soeng6 min6 sing1 hei2，coeng1 hoi1 dak1 hou2 daai6，keoi5 mong6 faan1 zyun3 tau4，gin3 dou3 jau5 go3 naam4 jan2 lok6 zo2 tiu4 tai1，keoi5 hou2 zing6 zing6 dei6，hou2 gung1 hoi1 gam2 lok6 lai4，ling6 dou3 go3 naam4 zai2 soeng2 zoeng6 dou3 keoi5 hai2 zau2 dim3 jap6 min6 zou6 je5。
text: 一個奶仔，喺去奶廠嘅路上，巧合噉行落酒店後面嘅小巷，佢留意到有條梯，通常都係喺度，喺二樓嘅其中一個窗上面升起，窗開得好大，佢望返轉頭，見到有個男人落咗條梯，佢好靜靜哋，好公開噉落嚟，令到個男仔想像到佢喺酒店入面做嘢。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: At my corner window table, I was reading the Esperanto science fiction book La Imperio Ornaks by A. Thorkent. My parents bought me the book from the Esperanto Museum in Vienna, which they visited years ago. I also carried with me a French-Esperanto mini dictionary from Paris, 1947, from Internet shopping. Lately, I've been researching Japanese "hako-chitsu" bookbinding, which I first encountered in the Asian Library of UBC, my university.

jyutping: hai2 ngo5 go3 gok3 lok6 ge3 coeng1 toi2 dou6，ngo5 tai2 gan2 A. sok3 hang2 dak6 ge3 sai3 gaai3 jyu5 fo1 waan6 siu2 syut3《 Imperio Ornaks 》。ngo5 fu6 mou5 hai2 wai4 jaa5 naap6 ge3 sai3 gaai3 jyu5 bok3 mat6 gun2 maai5 zo2 bun2 syu1 bei2 ngo5，keoi5 dei6 gei2 nin4 cin4 heoi3 gwo3 go2 dou6，ngo5 zung6 ceoi4 san1 kwai4 daai3 zo2 jat1 bun2 1947 nin4 hai2 baa1 lai4 maai5 ge3 faat3 jyu5 sai3 gaai3 jyu5 mai4 nei5 zi6 din2，zeoi3 gan6 ngo5 hai2 mong5 soeng6 kau3 mat6 go2 zan6 jin4 gau3 gan2 jat6 bun2 ge3「 hako-chitsu 」zong1 ding3 syu1。
text: 喺我個角落嘅窗枱度，我睇緊 A. 索肯特嘅世界語科幻小說《 Imperio Ornaks 》。我父母喺維也納嘅世界語博物館買咗本書畀我，佢哋幾年前去過嗰度，我仲隨身攜帶咗一本1947年喺巴黎買嘅法語世界語迷你字典，最近我喺網上購物嗰陣研究緊日本嘅「 hako-chitsu 」裝訂書。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: Daphnis, perceiving it, laid down his pipe and while he gazed on her charms, he thus sighed to himself: "What eyes are those which are now closed in sleep! What a mouth is that which breathes so sweetly! Neither apples nor wild-flowers have so sweet a scent! Ah! But I fear to kiss it! Her lips sting me to the heart, and like new honey drive me mad! Besides, a kiss would awaken her!"

jyutping: daat6 fu1 nei4 si1 gam2 zi1 dou3，fong3 dai1 zo2 keoi5 zi1 jin1 dau2，dong1 keoi5 mong6 zyu6 keoi5 ge3 mei6 lik6 go2 zan6，keoi5 deoi3 zi6 gei2 taan3 sik1：「go2 di1 ji4 gaa1 hai2 seoi6 min4 zung1 bai3 soeng5 lai4 ge3 ngaan5 zing1 hai6 mat1 je5 aa3！go2 go3 fu1 kap1 dak1 gam3 tim4 ge3 zeoi2 hai6 me1 aa3！ping4 gwo2 tung4 je5 faa1 dou1 mou5 gam3 tim4 ge3 hoeng1 mei6！aa3！daan6 ngo5 geng1 sek3 keoi5！keoi5 di1 seon4 wui5 ci3 dou3 ngo5 ge3 sam1，tung4 maai4 hou2 ci5 san1 ge3 fung1 mat6 gam2，wui5 ling6 ngo5 faat3 din1！」
text: 達夫尼斯感知到，放低咗佢支煙斗，當佢望住佢嘅魅力嗰陣，佢對自己嘆息：「嗰啲而家喺睡眠中閉上嚟嘅眼睛係乜嘢呀！嗰個呼吸得咁甜嘅嘴係咩呀！蘋果同野花都冇咁甜嘅香味！啊！但我驚錫佢！佢啲唇會刺到我嘅心，同埋好似新嘅蜂蜜噉，會令我發癲！」

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: About 6 in the drizzling morning, I headed walking towards Tim Hortons, here on Lulu Island. I had a chai tea with oat milk and a four-cheese savoury twist pastry. Later, my Cantonese friend Gary showed up; his family has been in this country for generations. Besides English, he speaks Cantonese and Mandarin. Some people want to live in a different country: Gary wants to live in Vietnam, specifically Ho Chi Minh City, for part of the year, as he has a girlfriend there. He said that he was not having too much language difficulty there, despite that I know that most signs there are in Vietnamese. He suggested that I buy property in the Philippines, where it would be much cheaper. I said that I do not really prefer a Xtian country. I talked about the city of Ayutthaya in Buddhist Thailand, full of expatriates admiring ancient temples there. Later, before 8 in that morning, I walked to Starbucks, and I waited for my Filipino friend Greg, but he did not show up this time. I was drinking an iced strawberry oat matcha latte. Today is the 5th of January of 2025.

jyutping: hai2 daam6 daam6 ge3 ziu1 zou2 luk6 dim2 gei2，ngo5 hoeng3 zyu6 hai2 nei1 dou6 lou6 lou6 dou2 ge3 Tim Hortons haang4 heoi3。ngo5 jam2 zo2 bui1 jin3 mak6 naai5 ge3 chai tea tung4 sei3 zi1 si2 haam4 mei6 nau2 sou1 pei2。hau6 loi4，ngo5 ge3 hoeng1 gong2 pang4 jau5 Gary ceot1 jin6 zo2；keoi5 uk1 kei2 jan4 hai2 ni1 go3 gwok3 gaa1 ji5 ging1 gei2 doi6 jan4。ceoi4 zo2 jing1 man2 zi1 ngoi6，keoi5 sik1 gong2 jyut6 jyu5 tung4 waa4 jyu5。jau5 di1 jan4 soeng2 zyu6 hai2 m4 tung4 ge3 gwok3 gaa1： Gary soeng2 hai2 jyut6 naam4，dak6 bit6 hai6 wu4 zi3 ming4 si5，jat1 nin4 ge3 bou6 fan6 si4 gaan3 zyu6，jan1 wai6 keoi5 hai2 go2 dou6 jau5 go3 neoi5 pang4 jau5。keoi5 waa6 keoi5 hai2 go2 dou6 m4 wui5 jau5 taai3 daai6 ge3 jyu5 jin4 kwan3 naan4，zeon2 gun2 ngo5 zi1 dou3 go2 dou6 daai6 bou6 fan6 ge3 biu1 zi3 dou1 hai6 jung6 jyut6 naam4 man4。keoi5 gin3 ji5 ngo5 heoi3 fei1 leot6 ban1 maai5 lau2，jan1 wai6 fei1 leot6 ban1 wui5 peng4 hou2 do1。ngo5 waa6 ngo5 m4 hai6 hou2 zung1 ji3 jat1 go3 Xtian gwok3 gaa1。ngo5 gong2 zo2 fat6 gaau3 taai3 gwok3 ge3 daai6 sing4 fu2，cung1 mun5 zyu6 hai2 go2 dou6 jan1 soeng2 gu2 miu2 ge3 ngoi6 zik6 jan4 si6。hau6 loi4，go2 ciu4 baat3 dim2 cin4，ngo5 haang4 heoi3 sing1 baa1 hak1，ngo5 dang2 gan2 ngo5 fei1 leot6 ban1 pang4 jau5 Greg ，daan6 hai6 keoi5 gam1 ci3 mou5 ceot1 jin6。ngo5 jam2 gan2 bui1 dung3 cou2 mui2 jin3 mak6 mut3 caa4 naa4 tit3。gam1 jat6 hai6 2025 nin4 1 jyut6 5 hou6。
text: 喺淡淡嘅朝早六點幾，我向住喺呢度露露島嘅 Tim Hortons 行去。我飲咗杯燕麥奶嘅 chai tea 同四芝士鹹味扭酥皮。後來，我嘅香港朋友 Gary 出現咗；佢屋企人喺呢個國家已經幾代人。除咗英文之外，佢識講粵語同華語。有啲人想住喺唔同嘅國家： Gary 想喺越南，特別係胡志明市，一年嘅部分時間住，因為佢喺嗰度有個女朋友。佢話佢喺嗰度唔會有太大嘅語言困難，儘管我知道嗰度大部分嘅標誌都係用越南文。佢建議我去菲律賓買樓，因為菲律賓會平好多。我話我唔係好鍾意一個 Xtian 國家。我講咗佛教泰國嘅大城府，充滿住喺嗰度欣賞古廟嘅外籍人士。後來，嗰朝八點前，我行去星巴克，我等緊我菲律賓朋友 Greg ，但係佢今次冇出現。我飲緊杯凍草莓燕麥抹茶拿鐵。今日係2025年1月5號。

author: Davidgo5867

english.text: It wasn't the fog I minded, Cathleen. I really love fog. It hides you from the world and the world from you. You feel that everything has changed, and nothing is what it seemed to be. No one can find or touch you any more. It's the foghorn I hate. It won't let you alone. It keeps reminding you, and warning you, and calling you back.

jyutping: m4 hai6 mou6 bun2 san1 ling6 ngo5 gaai3 ji3，Cathleen。ngo5 zan1 hai6 hou2 zung1 ji3 mou6。mou6 wui5 zoeng1 nei5 tung4 sai3 gaai3 gaak3 hoi1，zoeng1 sai3 gaai3 tung4 nei5 gaak3 hoi1。nei5 wui5 gok3 dak1 jat1 cai3 dou1 bin3 zo2 joeng6，mou5 jat1 joeng6 je5 zung6 ci5 zi1 cin4 ge3 mou4 joeng6。mou5 jan4 zoi3 wan2 dou2 nei5，zuk1 mo2 dou3 nei5。ngo5 tou2 jim3 ge3 hai6 go2 go3 mou6 hou6（foghorn）。keoi5 m4 hang2 fong3 gwo3 nei5，seng4 jat6 hai2 dou6 tai4 sing2 nei5、ging2 gou3 nei5、giu3 nei5 faan1 zyun3 tau4。
text: 唔係霧本身令我介意，Cathleen。我真係好鍾意霧。霧會將你同世界隔開，將世界同你隔開。你會覺得一切都變咗樣，冇一樣嘢仲似之前嘅模樣。冇人再搵到你，觸摸到你。我討厭嘅係嗰個霧號（foghorn）。佢唔肯放過你，成日喺度提醒你、警告你、叫你返轉頭。
